summary: Nu Ride Inc. (registrant) reported via Form 8-K that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Affinity Advisory Holdings Corp., agreed to acquire 100% of Affinity Advisory Network, LLC and AAN Wealth Advisors, LLC. Consideration: $6.72M cash (subject to working capital adjustments), 80,000 shares of Nu Ride Class A common stock, and 15% of the buyer's post-closing common stock, plus up to $1.312M earnout. Closing subject to customary conditions; board composition per Stockholders Agreement. The non-US filing is directly reported as an 8-K. Watch for regulatory clearance and risk-arb on equity component valuation.
